title: Elder Companion Care
shortDescription: Warm, reliable companionship for seniors living independently.
description: Our trained companions spend quality time with your loved ones — conversation, hobbies, light activity, and reassurance — so they never feel alone at home.
requirements: Client must be present at the registered address

title: Personal Hygiene & Grooming
description: Our caregivers assist with bathing, dressing, and grooming with patience and respect for privacy, helping clients maintain confidence and comfort every day.
requirements: Bathroom safety equipment recommended for mobility-limited clients

title: Post-Operative Care
shortDescription: Qualified nursing support for a safe recovery at home.
description: Registered nurses provide wound checks, medication administration, and vitals monitoring following surgery, coordinated with your treating physician.

title: Domestic Assistance / Cleaning
shortDescription: Reliable home cleaning support so you can focus on care.
description: Thorough, consistent housekeeping — from daily tidying to deep cleans — delivered by vetted domestic staff.
requirements: Cleaning supplies provided by client unless otherwise arranged

title: Mobility & Transport Support
shortDescription: Safe, accompanied travel for appointments and outings.
description: A trained companion accompanies clients to medical appointments, social visits, or errands, providing mobility support throughout the journey.
requirements: Destination & appointment time confirmed 24 hrs in advance

title: Dementia Care
shortDescription: Specialized, patient-centered support for memory care.
description: Caregivers trained in dementia-specific techniques provide structured routines, safety supervision, and compassionate engagement.
requirements: Care plan review with family before first visit
